definition: to keep going through a hard time
description: A narrow snowy mountain ridge high above a sea of clouds in cold morning light. A young woman in a blue down jacket, black trousers, frosted goggles and a woolly hat climbs steadily up the slope towards the viewer, holding a fixed rope with her gloved hand, her crampons biting into the snow and her face tired but determined. Behind her a man in a yellow beanie and a dark jacket follows on the same rope with his head down. The sun glows low behind the clouds.

de.answer: Sie steigt einen verschneiten Grat hinauf.
